scripts.dev:android: vite build --config vite.config.android.ts --mode development && bunx cap sync android
scripts.dev:android:package:models: vite build --config vite.config.android.ts --mode development -- --package-models && bunx cap sync android
scripts.dev:preview:desktop: vite build --config vite.config.desktop.ts --mode development && bunx electron .
scripts.build:desktop:production: bun run clean:desktop && bun run prepare:desktop:runtime-core && vite build --config vite.config.desktop.ts --mode production
scripts.build:desktop:win: bun run clean:desktop && bun run prepare:desktop:runtime-core && vite build --config vite.config.desktop.ts --mode production && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.win.json
scripts.build:desktop:win:dir: bun run clean:desktop && bun run prepare:desktop:runtime-core && vite build --config vite.config.desktop.ts --mode production && electron-builder --win --dir --config electron-builder.win.json
scripts.build:desktop:mac: bun run clean:desktop && bun run prepare:desktop:runtime-core && vite build --config vite.config.desktop.ts --mode production && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.mac.json
scripts.build:desktop:mac:dir: bun run clean:desktop && bun run prepare:desktop:runtime-core && vite build --config vite.config.desktop.ts --mode production && electron-builder --mac --dir --config electron-builder.mac.json
scripts.build:android: vite build --config vite.config.android.ts --mode production && bunx cap sync android
scripts.build:android:package:models: vite build --config vite.config.android.ts --mode production -- --package-models && bunx cap sync android
scripts.build:all: concurrently "vite build --mode production" "vite build --config vite.config.extension.ts --mode production"
